resolved_unknowns.reason: 已读学历资料未明确博士授予年份；未用求职、加入本校、首次任职或博士论文奖年份填充。

verification_history.note: Official CV re-read; dated fragments appended. Missing degree years stay unknown when education section omits dates; old current-at-check observations preserved.

career_review.rule: Same appointment matched on institution, rank, start year, compatible end year. Month precision enriches existing appointment; raw forms kept in evidence_versions and previous_versions. Unknown role join observations remain separate and uncounted as dated positions.

appointment_review.scope: Institution, business school and title checked independently of unknown DBA award year.
